measurement.S: As run 2 (commute.qwen_held.Held, arithmetic unchanged) except the fit rows: A = C G^+ with C and G summed over the chosen fit rows; S = 1 - KL(F||H) / KL(F||M), mean per position over rows 64-127 of the arm own row set; no change (None) when KL(F||M) <= s_floor_factor x the pair chosen-fit do-nothing KL(F||H) on that row set
measurement.fit_sweep: Stage 0, per row set of the pod, F = M, for each fit in settings.fits in order: do-nothing KL(F||M), KL(F||H), per-site residual on the read rows and max |A - W0| / max |W0| (control/<rowset>_fit_<name>.json)
measurement.choice: The first fit after own64 whose do-nothing KL(F||H) <= floor_max on both row sets of the pair; every read of the pair uses it
measurement.S_random: Per state read, the Gaussian change of settings.s_draw at that state's per-matrix norms, read for S by the same code on the same rows; for a rescaled read the same Gaussian times c
measurement.rescaled: Each state of the larger side at that save (settings.rescale) multiplied by c on every matrix and read again ('<key>_c'); the smaller side keeps its saved-size S
measurement.gap: Per pair, save and seed: S(reuse side) - S(new side). 'saved': both at saved size. 'matched': the larger side's S replaced by its rescaled S. Seeds are paired by seed number (seed s of one side with seed s of the other), as P3.9's gaps were (qwen_library_share/run.py summarise)

blind_to.S: Whether F's units are M's re-weighted or new directions M's units span on 16,384 positions (2.7 fit positions per MLP input, run 1's flag 5); the random change shares the rows and fit size. Attention-pattern changes enter only through F's write at o_proj. On a built side the read half repeats the fit half's cue sequences, so S there is read on the trained text itself
blind_to.gap: Which side's units change; a gap from a size difference is read only through the rescaled read, which E205 found lowers S on the 67M (0.0006-0.030), so it shrinks only the larger side
blind_to.fit_sweep: Why a fit fails: the sweep says which fit sources reproduce M on the read rows, not whether the cause is the span of the fit rows or the pseudo-inverse tolerance

measurement.positive_control: The pod's first state's change at o_proj and down_proj only, which reading 3 expresses exactly: S >= 0.999 (run 1 read 1 - 2.4e-8)
measurement.noise_floor: The chosen fit do-nothing KL(F||H) per row set (at most 1e-7 by the choice) sets the no change floor; run 1 seed sd of S (0.0041) under the bar (0.005); each side own seed sd over 3 seeds, reported

controls_stop_on_miss.fit_sweep: Stage 0: no fit after own64 reads do-nothing KL(F||H) <= 1e-7 on both row sets of the pair: the pod writes stopped.json and reads no state (the pair is unreadable by S at these fits)
controls_stop_on_miss.S_do_nothing: Every fit: F = M reads KL(F||M) <= 1e-9 per position
controls_stop_on_miss.S_output_only: Before the pod's first state is read: that state's o_proj and down_proj change alone reads S >= 0.999 (control/output_only.json)
controls_stop_on_miss.sha256: Each fetched state matches the library's recorded sha256 (library_states.fetch raises otherwise)
controls_stop_on_miss.rows: Each arm row set is 128 x 256 tokens; each repacked set 128 x 256; gold rows at least 64 x 256

expected.fit_own64: Reproduces run 2 do-nothing KL(F||H): cipher 1.247e-3, copy 2.237e-3, known 2.8e-4, invented 3.9e-4 (results/run2/<pair>/control/<rowset>_do_nothing.json); reported beside, no bar
expected.fit_others: No prior. If the read rows unit activations leave the span of the 64 fit rows, more and more varied fit rows lower the floor, the repacked rows (same sequences, new contexts) most; if the cause is numerical (the pseudo-inverse cutting real directions), no fit clears and the pod stops
expected.S_states: Between 0.95 and 0.999 at saved size (run 1 0.977-0.997; run 2 gold 0.996-0.999). Run 2 word-row S (0.93-0.99) carried the fit error and is not a prior
expected.S_random: About 0.75-0.85 when read (run 1 0.79-0.82; run 2 gold ~0.81); the smallest states random references may read no change
expected.S_rescaled: Each rescaled state S lower than its saved S by 0.0006-0.03 (E205, 67M); run 2 cipher shrink raised S 0.93 to 0.99 under the fit error, and gold shrink left it unchanged: whether shrinking raises S on clean word rows is what this reads
expected.gaps: Rival A: every seed gap above 0.005 at both saves, saved size and size-matched, on both word pairs; rival B: neither pair does. Run 2 under the fit error: saved-size gaps 0.014-0.066, size-matched 0.003-0.006
expected.seed_sd: Each side's seed sd of S under ~0.005 (run 1's largest 0.0041 at n 2)
expected.time: Per pod on an H100: stage 0 builds Grams over 64+64 (own64), 128, 320 and 384 fit rows and the 64 read rows per row set; run 2 measured 26-27 s for Grams and pinv over 128 rows and 14 s per do-nothing read, so about 13 s per 64 fit rows: ~4-5 min per row set, ~9 min per pod. Then run 2 state reads: 22 min per pod, fetch-bound (results/run2_copy_cipher_pod.log 00:53-01:13). With set-up ~10-15 min: ~45 min a pod, two pods in parallel, ~$3 each at $3.99/h; the rehearsal pod ~20 min, ~$1.5; ~$8 in all

gap.rule: summary2.gap_rule per pair, save and kind ('saved', 'matched'), on the three seeds' gaps: 'reuse above' if every gap > 0.005; 'new above' if every gap < -0.005; 'within bar' if every |gap| <= 0.005 or the gaps have both signs; 'mixed' otherwise; 'unreadable' if fewer than 3 gaps or any S of the cell reads 'no change' or is not finite. Rounded to 9 places
gap.pair: summary2.pair_outcome over the pair's four rules (2 saves x saved, matched): 'separates' if all four read 'reuse above'; 'reversed' if all four 'new above'; 'unreadable' if any is; else 'does not separate'
gap.outcome: summary2.outcome over the three pairs: 'rival A' if every pair separates; 'rival B' if no pair separates and none is unreadable (a 'reversed' pair counts here, and is announced as a reversal of the 67M's order); 'neither' otherwise (some pairs separate, or one is unreadable)

rules.S_random: Reported beside each read; no rule (run 1 already found every E167 state 0.17-0.19 above its random change)
rules.outcome: summary3.outcome over the two word pairs: rival A if both separate; rival B if neither separates and neither is unreadable (a reversed pair counts here, announced as a reversal of the 67M order); neither otherwise (one separates, or one is unreadable, including a pod stopped at stage 0)
